name: an allocation reversal takes collected back to zero and the delta is the whole accrual, negative

expected.workings: allocatedPaise is SIGMA(apply) - SIGMA(reverse), so a 100000 apply followed by its reversal reads 0 -- and it must not be subtracted a second time. eligibleBase = 100000. settleable = 100000 - 0 = 100000. collected = 0 - 0 = 0. targetBase = divHalfUp(100000 x 0, 100000) = floor((0 + 100000) / 200000) = 0. target = percentAmount(0, 1000) = 0. delta = 0 - 10000 = -10000, which is the whole accrual given back through the SAME line of code that made it. A consumer subscribed only to payment.received / payment.refunded never sees this event at all and keeps the 10000.
